description:
Yet another cross-platform graphical process/system monitor.


A small update with a new feature (an option to show zeroed total network usage on startup) and some bug fixes.
Bug Fixes
- #2207: Fix typo in --help flag (thanks @Oseryx!)
- #2210: Fix handling Linux cmdline values that don't have null byte separators (thanks @fxzzi!)
Features
- #2199: Add option to show zeroed total network usage on startup
New Contributors
- @Oseryx made their first contribution in #2207
- @fxzzi made their first contribution in #2210
Full Changelog: 0.14.8...0.14.9
